create_MistralTokenizer: create a MistralTokenizer instance from a pretrained model path or repository ID
apply_chat_template_MistralTokenizer: apply a chat template to a list of messages and optional tools and return token IDs
encode_MistralTokenizer: encode a text string into a list of token IDs with optional truncation and special tokens
decode_MistralTokenizer: decode a sequence of token IDs back into a text string with optional special token skipping
adapt_inplace_to_mistral_tool: adapt an OpenAI-style tool dict to Mistral format by adding missing fields and removing unsupported keys
